description: Alenza 2019 is sourced from Maricalva, described by Condado de Haza as own vineyards in the municipal areas of Roa and La Horra at roughly 800 metres. CARTA stores this source-described area without parcel geometry or invented coordinates.

Scar of the Sea describes Bassi Vineyard on south-facing sandstone hillsides in Avila Valley, about 1.2 miles from Avila Beach, within the SLO Coast AVA. No vineyard coordinates or polygon are asserted.

Ashes & Diamonds places its estate vineyard in the Oak Knoll District of Napa Valley and describes its alluvial soils and Cabernet Franc block. CARTA records the appellation-level placement without vineyard geometry.

Rosenthal describes Les Peyrouses as an old-vines parcel on the flats in the commune of Cornas, while the wine is Côtes du Rhône Rouge. INAO separately defines the Cornas AOP as a delimited area within the sole commune. CARTA preserves that legal/geographic distinction without guessing the parcel's position relative to the AOP polygon.
